title: Sea shader construction
summary: Recovered wsShaderSea constructor at VA 0x577320 (RVA 0x177320), 533 bytes, as a no-argument thiscall SeaShader::construct member returning this. Original finalizer caller at 0x534ee8 supplies a successful 0xcc-byte allocation. Uses accepted base and common-parameter helpers as explicit external member dependencies. Installs original vtable identity, selects the fixed manager shader pair, clears specific state, initializes an identity-shaped 16-float region, and performs eleven ordered stdcall constant-table slot-9 lookups with parent zero. Common binding follows and overwrites +0x3c/+0x44. Table fields are read again for each call. Implementation leaves +0xc9..0xcb untouched. Exact original disassembly and strings were inspected; four linked accepted references were independently compared byte-for-byte with immutable Game.exe. This is readable unmatched source with zero matching-byte credit.
test_description: GCC i386 freestanding fixed-flag differential harness passed 256 cases against original_shader_sea_ctor at its actual address, using accepted base/common/lookup references. Exact fixture sizes: .oracle_rdata 0xe0000, .oracle_cookie 4, .oracle_manager 4, .oracle_seh 32. Test-owned string fixtures were extracted from original evidence. Explicit initialized test_install_fs backing is required; original constructor and every explicitly called original dependency are followed by FS restoration checks. Inputs cover varied poisoned object bytes, zero/high-bit shader tokens, distinct/aliased tables, all/nonzero/mixed missing direct handles, failed/empty/successful common descriptors, absent indexed handles, ignored constant-description failure, callback replacement of table fields, and either/both table fields becoming null before common binding. Comparisons include complete callback order, table identity, name hash, parent/index/count arguments and intermediate object snapshots; complete guarded object equality, return identity, matrix bits through byte comparison, flag/state initialization, untouched tail and surrounding canaries. Cookie and initial FS head vary. Fixed source compiles without warnings under GCC Wall/Wextra/Werror; C++11 implementation compilation is also checked. MSVC helper is absent locally; native Windows compatibility validation is delegated to the trusted coordinator.
known_limits: Normal paths only. Windows SEH registration/unwind handler 0x907fb6, exception dispatch, TEB services and throwing callbacks are not implemented or exercised. The original oracle uses audited normal-path FS setup; recovered source relies on host exception conventions.

Base initialization, common binding and parameter lookup remain external accepted dependencies, not expanded recovered scope. Test adapters call original references; a Linux port must supply those dependencies and seaShaderManager.
Manager and initial constant tables must be valid; the original constructor dereferences them without null checks. Null common tables are tested only after the final direct callback.

The fixed 32-bit vtable identity is retained as an ABI token, not a usable native Linux virtual table. The declared object layout is the original 32-bit layout; a 64-bit port requires an explicit layout/handle adaptation.

Names infer parameter meanings, but runtime purpose of the identity-shaped float region and unknown state/flag fields remains unconfirmed. Real D3DX rendering, COM lifetimes and OS internals are outside controlled callbacks.

No matching-source claim. Native MSVC2013 compiler was unavailable locally; implementation uses C++11-compatible syntax and guarded compiler ABI declarations. The readable initialization loop may generate different instructions and write order before the first callback. Valid ordinary nonvolatile object storage is assumed.
